The '''sorties against [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]]''' were twelve attacks on the shipyards at [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] conducted by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Keir Santage/Legends|Keir Santage]] participated in the raids.
